items.text: 新增公众号文章项目，集中管理原稿、标题与封面历史，并支持六种真实排版主题的预览、复制和下载。
items.text_en: Add article projects to manage source text, title and cover history, with preview, copy and download across six distinct layouts.

items.text: 画布模型管理支持按精确运行选项启停候选，并为画布、Hypit 和文章流程提供共享配置画布。
items.text_en: Canvas model management can enable or disable exact run options and provides shared configuration canvases for Canvas, Hypit and articles.

items.text: 新增五套完整主题，并将主题身份与浅色、深色及系统外观偏好分开保存。
items.text_en: Add five complete themes and store theme identity separately from light, dark and system appearance preferences.

items.text: 改进候选目录、配置画布状态同步、页面首屏加载及窄屏滚动，避免筛选或刷新中断当前选择。
items.text_en: Improve candidate catalogs, configuration-canvas state sync, startup loading and narrow-screen scrolling so filtering or refresh does not interrupt current selections.
